title: RunEvidence
description: DRAFT until ADR 0067 is Accepted (F8-WO1: the envelope). ADR 0067 D6: `artifacts/run-evidence.json` of a v2 run, its evidence by class: verification, validation, optimality, the extensions it used, and evidence notices (which never enter the certificate). Outside every identity: not in `r0_projection`, not in `structural_sha256`, not in a certificate check (D6, D9). The members of a validation entry and of an extension row are F8-WO4's (built with F4-WO4); this envelope holds them as objects.

certificate.description: The certificate's artifact name, or null for a run without one.

entries.description: Each (component, entry) the composition read, once, judged at the converged state (Q9.R6). Members: F8-WO4.

extensions.description: One row per entry of the manifest's `extensions_used` with its evidence fields (ADR 0060 D9). Members: F8-WO4.

notices.description: Evidence notices (`extension_unreviewed`, `preview_kind`), as catalogued codes and their params.
